# Blue Pillow Hotels & Stays

Blue Pillow provides AI agents with hotel and stay discovery, live offer comparison, recommendations, validation, and tracked booking handoff.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bluepillow/.

## Actions

- **Create Booking Handoff**: Create only a tracked Blue Pillow handoff link for the user to continue the booking process.
- **Discover Destinations Near Coordinates** (read-only): Find cities, neighborhoods, airports, or points of interest near geographic coordinates.
- **Get Property** (read-only): Get canonical details and optional review enrichments for one property.
- **Recommend Offer for Property** (read-only): Compare live OTA offers and recommend the best offer for a property the user has already selected.
- **Recommend Stay** (read-only): Rank a location to one recommended stay plus alternatives.
- **Resolve Destination** (read-only): Resolve a place name into destination IDs for stay search, including ambiguity and confidence information.
- **Search Stays** (read-only): Search one page of ranked live stay inventory with availability, prices, OTA offers, and an opaque cursor for more results.
- **Validate Offer** (read-only): Re-price a previously seen EUR offer and report whether it remains valid within the provider's two-percent tolerance.
